title: Deals: Pixel 11 series goes on pre-order, Galaxy Z8 foldables and S26 models drop prices
description: Google launched its new Pixel 11 series earlier this week – there is a new vanilla, two new Pro and one new foldable model. All that’s missing now is an affordable a-phone. The massive increase in RAM prices has affected the Pixel series. Google now offers 256GB storage as standard on all 11-series models, which is a good thing, but the Pixel 11 Pro and 11 Pro XL start with 12GB of RAM. If you want 16GB (which is what all Pixel 10 Pro and 10 Pro XL phones had), you will have to get a 512GB or a 1TB model. title: iQOO Buds TWS earphones launching on August 20
description: iQOO will launch the Z11 in India on August 20, and on the same day, the brand will also unveil the iQOO Buds TWS earphones. The teaser posted by iQOO's Indian branch on X reveals the iQOO Buds' design. These are in-ear type and have silicone ear tips, which should offer passive noise cancellation. However, it is unclear whether they will have active noise cancellation. The iQOO Buds' charging case has an LED indicator on the front, above which is the brand logo. At the bottom is the USB-C port. iQOO hasn't revealed the features of the iQOO Buds yet, but we might see the brand...

title: Google is adding tons of new customization options to Android 17
description: Google just dropped the Android 17 QPR2 Beta 3 update to eligible Pixel devices, and in addition to squashing a few bugs, the new software introduces some cool new features as well. The most notable change is the ability to customize the Quick Settings menu. Quick Settings layout editor With Android 17, Google is adding a new Quick Settings layout editor that allows you to arrange pretty much all of the toggles and settings. You can choose which quick toggles to make into bigger tiles and even move the brightness slider and the media player around. More theming options will...

title: iQOO Neo11 Ultra full specs sheet leaks, launch is imminent
description: The iQOO Neo11 Ultra is expected to launch in a few days and shortly after the company teased the phone, confirming the Dimensity 9500M chipset, the popular Weibo tipster Digital Chat Station revealed the rest of the hardware, leaving almost nothing to the imagination. In fact, the leak goes into surprisingly a lot of detail, at least when it comes to the screen. The device will launch with a flat 6.83-inch display with a 144Hz refresh rate, but it will be a regular LTPS panel, not LTPO. title: Google now lets you remove Gemini's visible watermark
description: Google's Nano Banana image generator is pretty good but some people have been put off by the fact that its images have a visible watermark in the bottom right corner, unlike the images generated with ChatGPT's latest model. So now Google is finally letting you choose to remove the watermark. There's a new setting for this that you will see in Gemini and Flow, and it will also be available in Google Search's AI Mode soon. And the good news is that it's not just for images. You'll also be able to remove watermarks from videos created with Gemini Omni and songs created with Lyria. The...

title: Poco starts teasing the M8x 5G, shows us a glimpse of its back
description: Poco launched the M8 and M8 Pro in January, the M8s in April, and the M8 Power earlier this month, but now it turns out that there's a fifth member of the family on the way too. This will be called the M8x, and Poco has started teasing it today via a dedicated microsite on Flipkart. That tells us where you'll be able to buy it once it launches. We also get the teaser image you can see below, showing us a glimpse of the phone's back. The microsite reveals that this device will support 5G, and that's it for now. More specs should be revealed in the coming days and weeks, and we'll...

title: Honor Robot Phone hands-on review
description: In the somewhat stale smartphone market, Honor decided to shake things up a bit and finally launched the much-anticipated Honor Robot Phone. As the name implies, it's no ordinary phone, and it doesn't belong to the already existing Honor smartphone lineups. Instead, the Robot Phone bags several "industry first" technologies and it's built on over 100 patents. And if the photos are not obvious enough, the centerpiece feature is the robot arm-like gimbal that extends and can do all sorts of stuff. Honor says it's the world's most compact gimbal, weighing only 2.6g and being 6mm thin....

title: Here's when Huawei's non-folding wide-screen phone is launching
description: Following up on the success of the Pura X, Huawei has, for quite some time now, been working on a new non-folding smartphone with a similar 16:10 screen aspect ratio. This device is now rumored to be launching in September. According to a previous leak, it will be powered by a Kirin 9-series chipset, and will have a battery capacity of at least 7,000 mAh. The device is also said to have a 50MP main camera using a 1/1.3" type sensor, as well as a 50MP periscope telephoto camera and a multispectral camera. title: Here's our first look at Samsung's upcoming One UI 9.5
description: While Samsung is still in the process of beta testing One UI 9, with the fifth beta having gone out to the Galaxy S26 series just a couple of days ago, the company is also already working on One UI 9.5. This may be the version that the upcoming Galaxy S27 family will ship with out of the box. An enterprising X user has now installed a leaked One UI 9.5 firmware on their Galaxy S26 to see what it looks like, and the screenshots below show what you can expect. title: Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro emerges in AnTuTu test run
description: Qualcomm is expected to unveil its next-generation flagship chipset – the Snapdragon 8 Gen 6 Pro at the annual Snapdragon Summit next month, and it just leaked in an AnTuTu 11 benchmark run. The SM8975, as it is known internally, managed an impressive 4.83 million points. For reference, the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 usually hits between 4 and 4.6 million points. This means the upcoming chip offers a mere 5% boost in AnTuTu. Though, as usual with leaked benchmark runs, this is likely unfinished hardware, so the scores should be taken with a few grains of salt. Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6...

title: LG joins forces with Nvidia to build AI-powered robots and hardware for self-driving cars
description: Chairman and CEO of LG Corp. Kwang Mo Koo visited the Nvidia headquarters at Santa Clara, California, to sign a memorandum of understanding with CEO Jensen Huang. This memorandum focuses on expanding the AI capabilities of both companies. LG and Nvidia CEOs posing with a miniature humanoid robot The headline-grabbing announcement is that LG plans to unveil a humanoid robot in the first quarter of 2027. title: Judge forces Google to remove friction from third-party app store installations
description: Google has recently started distributing third-party app stores through its Play Store in the US, following a court ruling and its settlement with Epic Games. Now, Google has been ordered by US District Judge James Donato to remove its scary warnings that are shown when users want to install a third-party app store from Google Play. According to the court, Google is engaging in "anticompetitive friction" intended to prevent users from installing third-party app stores. The company has to make installing an alternative app store as easy as installing an Android app from the Play Store....

description: Today, we are going to do a very quick hands-on with the new range of devices from Google for 2026, including but not limited to the new Pixel 11 series of smartphones. There are a lot of devices to go through, so let’s just jump in without much further ado. Let’s start from the bottom with the new Pixel 11 series, with the eponymous model. The Pixel 11 comes with fewer changes over its predecessor compared to the Pro models, but they are all still welcome improvements that potential buyers would appreciate. title: vivo Y31T image and specs leak
description: vivo launched the Y31 in September of last year, and now it's allegedly working on the Y31T. This will apparently be launching in India soon. The image below purportedly shows its back. The Y31T is said to come with a 6.75-inch LCD screen with an HD+ resolution and 1,250-nit peak brightness. It will be powered by the Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 chipset, and it will have UFS 2.2 storage. The device will reportedly be offered in three configurations: 4/128GB, 6/128GB, and 6/256GB. It will have a 7,200 mAh battery with support for 44W fast charging. title: Tecno Pova AI Buds Pro bring AI recording and call summarization
description: Tecno recently unveiled the Pova 8 Pro and Pova 8 Pro 5G Tonino Lamborghini Limited Edition, with the standard model confirmed to launch in India on August 18. While we wait for the Pova 8 Pro to arrive, the company has introduced its Pova AI Buds Pro in the country. AI is the main highlight of Tecno's latest TWS earbuds, with the Pova AI Buds Pro offering AI-powered real-time speech transcription, meeting summaries, and translation support for up to 78 languages. title: Instagram gets a new wordmark for the first time in over 10 years
description: Meta has introduced a refreshed wordmark for Instagram, featuring a new font and styling while retaining elements of the original design. The updated wordmark is now visible at the top of Instagram's mobile apps. Instagram head Adam Mosseri announced the new wordmark in posts on Instagram and Threads, noting that the previous design had remained unchanged for 10 years and was due for a refresh. description: Last year, reports confirmed that Apple had picked Alibaba to power its Apple Intelligence features in China. A new report from Reuters News suggests that Apple has finalized training its China-specific LLM, which will be powered by Alibaba’s Qwen AI. This development is noteworthy as Apple would be the first foreign company to get approval from Chinese regulators to offer a proprietary AI model in China.
